text:
sam: Hi team, quick onboarding calendar question. My invites for Monday show events at 15:00 UTC but my calendar doesn't translate it to my local TZ (I9m in CET). Also the Zoom link in Outlook lost the passcode line. Where should I look for recordings and canonical links?

lina: Hey @sam, recordings are uploaded to the onboarding Google Drive in "New Hires/Session Recordings". We usually paste the canonical Zoom link + passcode into the event description after the meeting.

sam: I checked that folder but don't see last Thursday's "Security & Infra" session. Could be a permissions thing.

marc: @sam we temporarily put that file in a private queue while we blur a whiteboard with customer data. I added you to the ACLs just now. Refresh Drive and you should see it.

harper: For timezones: sometimes Gmail/Outlook shows the creator's timezone literal like "UTC" and doesn't auto-convert if your calendar account has a conflicting timezone setting. Try Settings -> Time Zone and ensure primary TZ is correct. If that fails, DM me and I can re-send an invite with an explicit locale-bound time.

sam: thanks marc, saw the recording now. marc: quick Q 50 are we expecting the product tour to start at 16:30 UTC or 16:00 UTC? Different invites on my calendar.

marc: Official start is 16:00 UTC. The duplicate 16:30 invite is a stale draft that sneaked in; you can delete it. Keep the one that says "Onboarding: Product Tour (official)".

sched-bot: Zoom meeting scheduled: ID 222-333-444, passcode: 8842 (posted automatically)

harper: I'll paste the join link + passcode into the event description and here after the session. Also I'll scribe notes. Can someone remind me if we need to redact slide 7?

lina: Yes, redact slide 7 and 1250 they contain vendor PII. Marc will handle the redaction before we move the file to the shared folder.

sam: One last thing 50 Outlook stripped the meeting notes thread for me. Do we have a canonical place for session notes?

marc: We keep notes in the session doc in Drive (linked from the calendar). If you can't find it, search "Onboarding Session Notes" or ping me and I'll drop the link.

sam: great, thanks everyone. Appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
